qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: While Aalberts benefits from installer specification and niche positioning in hydronic flow control, piping systems, and surface treatments, historical GAAP ROIC (~5-8%) fails the 12% hurdle across cycles, diluted by capital-heavy acquisitions and cyclical exposure to European building construction.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12%, REJECT). Multi-cycle GAAP ROIC (~5-8%) fails the 12% Munger hurdle; returns and operating margins (<10% in downturns) diluted by European construction cyclicality and serial M&A goodwill.
qualitative.evidence: ROIC persistently between 4.8% and 8.0%, well below the 12% threshold. Operating margins compress below 10% during building downturns. Capital allocation reliant on debt-funded bolt-on acquisitions without generating superior per-share compounding.
